text:
lin: Heads-up — we need a new GPU node pool in asia-southeast2 for the recommendation batch jobs. Current us-central pools are saturated and cross-region replication is costing too much.

ashley: How many GPUs are we targeting? Do we want preemptible/spot or reserved?

lin: Initial estimate 40 A100 GPUs (40x1). Jobs are intermittent: big nightly window + some ad-hoc replay. Prefer lower cost but want predictable burst for SLAs. Thinking mixed: majority preemptible, plus a small reserved core for critical replays.

infra-bot: quota check: project redwood-prod currently has 12 A100 GPUs in asia-southeast2, 0 available. Recommend filing quota increase via GCP console and CC-ing infra@.

jon: For mixed pools, we could create two nodepools: gpua100-core (6 x A100, N-1 size) reserved, and gpua100-burst (spot, autoscaled up to 100 nodes but with conservative pod limits). Autoscaler settings matter — set expander: priority, balance-similar-node-groups, and max-unready 1.

maria: Cost check: A100 per-hour is expensive in that region. Have you considered G5 (A10G equivalent) for cheaper inference? Batch jobs are throughput bound and tolerate lower perf per GPU. Could reduce ops cost ~35%.

lin: Good point. We profiled earlier: A100 halves runtime for our fp16 kernels but G5 might be 60% slower, still acceptable for non-latency-critical replays. Let's size two flavors: A100 reserved pool for heavy jobs and G5 spot pool for bulk.

ashley: If we do that, we'll need node selectors/taints to schedule correctly. Proposal: taint gpu=a100:NoSchedule on A100 pool, gpu=g5:NoSchedule on G5 pool, and add tolerations to the batch-controller. Also create pod priority classes: high for critical, low for bulk.

jon: Autoscaler flags I recommend: --balance-similar-node-groups, --scale-down-unneeded-time=10m, --scale-down-delay-after-add=15m, max nodes for burst pool 200 (cap on cost). For GKE: use NodeAutoProvisioning? probably not for GPUs. Create manual node pools.

maria: Quota request text you can submit: "Request increase of GPUs in asia-southeast2: +100 GPUs (A100 x40, G5 x60) for Redwood Inference production workload. Workload: nightly batch recommendation generation and on-demand replays, will use mixed reserved + preemptible pools. Contact: lin@redwood.com". That should pass.

lin: I'll file the quota ticket. Anyone object to defaulting to regional GKE vs zonal? Zonal might be simpler for GPU quota but regional gives AZ resilience.

sudhanshu: I'd vote zonal for initial roll: reduces cross-AZ GPU scheduling complexity and quota fragmentation. Use 1 primary zone asia-southeast2-a, add a second zone later if needed.

kate: Also remember to request CPU and local SSD quota increases for the node types. A100 nodes need 96+ vCPUs and 1-2TB local SSD depending on instance (n1-standard vs a2-highgpu). Include that in the ticket.

lin: Thanks — I'll include vCPU and SSD numbers. Drafting ticket now. I'll post the quota request link here once submitted and include a cost estimate. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: deploy-check: please ensure node pool IAM binds for service-account redwood-gke-node-sa and enable GPU drivers DaemonSet (nvidia-driver-installer).

jon: Quick example gcloud snippet for the burst (spot) pool: ```gcloud container node-pools create gpua100-burst --cluster=prod-cluster --zone=asia-southeast2-a --machine-type=a2-highgpu-1g --accelerator type=nvidia-tesla-a100,count=1 --num-nodes=0 --enable-autoscaling --min-nodes=0 --max-nodes=100 --preemptible --node-taints=gpu=a100:NoSchedule --node-labels=pool=burst,gpu=a100```

lin: Perfect. I'll attach that in the ticket and set up the CI job to validate scheduling. Will follow up with the final numbers.

ashley: Thanks. Once quota approved we'll run a smoke batch and watch the autoscaler behavior before enabling production traffic.

lin: Agreed. Last note: let's keep a conservative pod-to-gpu packing (1 pod per GPU) to avoid oversubscription until we validate multi-tenant GPU sharing.

infra-bot: ticket created: https://console.cloud.google.com/iam-admin/quotas?project=redwood-prod&ticket=Q-2026-4532

lin: Link received, thanks infra-bot. I'll @everyone when it's approved.
